name: motion-duration-by-distance
title: Distance-scaled Duration
description: Bài học: quãng đường gấp 4 thì thời lượng chỉ gấp khoảng 2, tỷ lệ với căn bậc hai quãng đường.

moworks.author: moworks

options.reference: units (60 here; 200 px in a product)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Three dots travel 60 / 120 / 240 px from the same start in 300 / 420 / 600 ms power2.inOut. Rule: duration ≈ base × √(distance / reference): 200 px → 300 ms, 800 px → 600 ms. Params: base (0.3 s cho 200 px) · distance. Duration ≈ base × √(distance / reference): four times the distance takes about twice as long.
